interaction.web: Toggling the switch (click or Space) updates showValues for every row and calls onShowValuesChange. Clicking the copy button writes name, value or an export line to navigator.clipboard, sets the copied state, calls onCopy, and clears the state after the timeout, with a cleanup on unmount.

semantics.web: The toggle is a role=switch with aria-label Toggle value visibility; the title is an h3. The copy button is an icon-only Button named "Copy <NAME>" (then "<NAME> copied") from the variable name in context, unless the caller passes aria-label. Masked values are bullet characters, not the secret.
